item.text: The base bolt is built. You can follow the model in the [AgentCAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8772/#part.FCStd). I’ll check the head and shank proportions before adding the thread.

arguments.code:
import math
R=8.660254
L=30.0
head=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=L).polygon(6,2*R).extrude(5.5)
head=head.edges('>Z').chamfer(0.7)
shaft=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(5).extrude(L)
pitch=1.25
thread=cq.Wire.makeHelix(pitch,17.5,5)
cutter=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(5.2,-0.48),(4.45,0),(5.2,0.48)]).close().sweep(thread,isFrenet=True)
result=head.union(shaft.cut(cutter))
arguments.label: Bolt with helical thread
